title: From Tickets to Tech, Here Are 22 of the Best Christmas Gifts for Music Lovers to Shop Online
summary: Priced between $10 and $400, these gifts have something for everyone, from the KPop Demon Hunters fan in your life to the tech enthusiast who’s always after the latest audio gear.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

It’s that time of year again, when the holiday season sneaks up on us and suddenly everyone’s scrambling to find presents that say “I know you” instead of “I panic-bought this on Dec. 23.”

But this year, we’re getting ahead of the curve with our Hanukkah and Christmas gifts, and treating holiday shopping like a well-produced album rollout : thoughtful, strategic and ideally free of last-minute scrambling.

The key is to shop for the person, not just the occasion. Got a friend who shreds on guitar ? Official Fender-inspired candles might just hit the right note. A sister with a budding music career? Get her a wireless microphone that connects to a mobile studio app. And for the cousin who’s a suit by day and a headbanger by night, Ticketmaster , StubHub and Vivid Seats offer e-gift cards to help fund their next concert. From $10 stocking stuffers to $400 tech, we scoured the internet to find Hanukkah and Christmas gifts music lovers will actually want , so you can skip the research rabbit hole and get straight to the good part: hitting that “buy” button.

'80S-INSPIRED SPEAKER

Bumpboxx Retroboom Speaker

$299

Buy Now at amazon

Bring the ’80s back with this bold boombox, which packs 200W peak power, booming bass and reactive RGB lights into one seriously retro package. It offers up to 30 hours of playtime, a wireless microphone and water resistance for parties on the beach. Choose from colors Onyx Black, Classic Silver or Radical Red.

PUZZLE

Music Cats 500 Piece Family Puzzle

$14.99

Buy Now at mudpuppy

$17.96

Buy Now at walmart

Cat people and music lovers, this one’s for you. Mudpuppy’s 500-piece puzzle reimagines legendary musicians as feline superstars, including Prince, Dolly Parton and The Notorious C.A.T. It’s a playful family activity for ages 8 and up, with recycled paper puzzle pieces and packaging that make the gift even more appealing.

TRIVIA

Misunderstood Songs Trivia Game

200+ Bought in the Past

$17

$18

Buy Now at brass monkey

Think you know every lyric to your favorite songs? Think again. I’ve played this game and approve, but be warned: These hilariously misheard lyrics will stump even the biggest music buffs. With 300 cards and competitive or casual gameplay for two to eight players, it’s a guaranteed party starter.

CD PLAYER

Rechargeable Portable CD Player with Dual Stereo Speakers

#1 New Release

$30.93

Yes, CD players are now a No. 1 in the New Release categories, and we’re not complaining about the format’s resurgence . This rechargeable player features built-in speakers, Bluetooth connectivity and a headphone jack for listening in private. It also plays MP3s from USB drives and comes in cream, white, black, green, pink or purple.

BOOK

'Karma Is Three Cats: Life According to Taylor Swift’s Kitty Best Friends'

For Swifties and cat lovers, this charming picture book tells Taylor Swift’s story through the eyes of her three beloved cats: Meredith Grey, Olivia Benson and Benjamin Button. Beautifully illustrated and full of the sass you’d expect from Swift’s feline entourage, it’s a sweet gift for young readers and a fun collectible for fans of the pop superstar.

KARAOKE

Adult Karaoke Machine with 2 Wireless Microphones

#1 Bestseller

$105.99

A bestseller with 2,000 purchases on Amazon in the past month, this karaoke machine features 200W sound, two wireless microphones, pitch correction and Bluetooth 5.3. It also connects to a compatible TV for displaying lyrics and offers up to 24 hours of battery life.

RECORD PLAYER

Victrola Journey Bluetooth Suitcase Record Player

400+ Bought in the Past Month

$59.99

$82.99

Buy Now at wayfair

I own this Victrola record player in black, but it comes in 12 colors. The fact that it looks like a stylish briefcase means it acts as cute home décor too. It plays vinyl at three speeds and doubles as a Bluetooth speaker for streaming music from your phone. Trust me, Adéla’s “Nicole Kidman” sounds especially good through its old-school speaker.

CANDLES

Fender Three Chord Candle Gift Set

Set of 3

$70

Buy Now at revolve

Buy Now at nordstrom

Buy Now at bloomingdale's

Buy Now at voluspa

Give your favorite guitar hero a gift that smells as good as it looks. Inspired by Fender guitars, these Voluspa candles feature decorative jars with a distinctive guitar pick on the front. The three-candle set includes Vanilla Voltage, Strawberry Rush and Midnight Leather, though each scent is also available to purchase individually .

HEADPHONES

Noise-Canceling Nothing Headphone (1) Pro

1K Bought in the Past Month

$399

Buy Now at best buy

Designed for serious listening, Nothing’s Headphone (1) Pro features a triple-driver system, adaptive noise cancellation, and up to 68 hours of playback. BTS’ V and Nothing ambassador modeled the headphones , saying, “Headphone (1) Pro is a design grounded in creative expression, and I look forward to our journey together.” Shop them in black or white.

EARPHONES

JLab's Wireless Earbuds

Budget-Friendly Editor Pick

$16.99

Need a budget-friendly set of earphones for someone who’s always listening to music? JLab’s Go Air Pop earbuds deliver more than 32 hours of total playtime, three EQ sound settings and a charging case with a built-in USB cable. They’re sweat-resistant for workouts and available in black, lilac, mint, pink, slate, teal and pony colors.

MUSICIAN'S SPEAKER

Fender Audio Elie 6 Bluetooth Speaker

$284

Fender’s Elie 6 brings the brand’s iconic musical heritage to a portable Bluetooth speaker with 60W of power, spatial audio and four input channels for instruments and microphones. I especially love that it has three listening modes, including Multi-Mode, which connects up to 100 compatible speakers. Available in black or white, it’s built for musicians and music fans alike.

EARPLUGS

Loop Switch 2 Adjustable Earplugs – 3 Modes

5K Bought in the Past Month

Buy Now at loop

I swear by my Loop earplugs for concerts and music festivals because I can still hear the music clearly while protecting my eardrums at the same time — nobody’s invincible when it comes to hearing damage. I even wear mine during loud construction work outside my window. The Loop Switch 2 offers three adjustable noise-reduction modes in six colors.

COLORING BOOK

For the Midwest Princess fan who loves a creative outlet, this unofficial Chappell Roan coloring book features more than 20 hand-drawn illustrations celebrating her bold fashion, music and personality. Packed with trivia and fun facts about the pop star, it’s best enjoyed with your brightest gel pens, sparkly supplies and favorite Chappell Roan hits playing in the background.

SPEAKER

Denon Home 200

Buy Now at denon

The Denon Home 200 delivers immersive stereo sound in a sleek speaker. I’m a big fan of its HEOS app, which lets you connect multiple compatible speakers throughout your home for a more surround-sound listening experience. It’s ideal for hosting a party.
